## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] No `as any` / new implicit `any`
- [ ] User-facing input touching a file path, spawned process, or DOM is validated (see `CLAUDE.md` → Security Architecture)
- [ ] If renderer logic with a canonical tested twin changed (e.g. `sort-utils.ts`), both copies are updated
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated if user-facing
